description:
Your call center has contracted with Flowroute as its VoIP provider for outbound dialing. You need to configure a new SIP carrier/trunk in the Vicidial admin interface so Asterisk can route calls through Flowroute's SIP gateway.

Navigate to the Carriers section in the Vicidial admin panel and create a new carrier with the following exact configuration:

- **Carrier ID:** FLOWRT01
- **Carrier Name:** Flowroute Primary SIP Trunk
- **Server IP:** Use the active server's IP address (check Admin -> Servers to find the IP of the active server)
- **Protocol:** SIP
- **Registration String:**
  register => 47839201:Frt2025xK@sip.flowroute.com
- **Account Entry:**
  [flowroute-trunk]
  type=peer
  host=sip.flowroute.com
  username=47839201
  secret=Frt2025xK
  fromuser=47839201
  fromdomain=sip.flowroute.com
  qualify=yes
  nat=force_rport,comedia
  disallow=all
  allow=ulaw
  allow=alaw
  insecure=port,invite
  context=trunkinbound
- **Dialplan Entry:**
  exten => _1NXXNXXXXXX,1,AGI(agi://127.0.0.1:4577/call_log)
  exten => _1NXXNXXXXXX,2,Dial(SIP/${EXTEN}@flowroute-trunk,,tTo)
  exten => _1NXXNXXXXXX,3,Hangup()

Submit the carrier configuration after entering all fields.

**Vicidial Admin Credentials:**
- URL: http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php
- User: 6666
- Password: andromeda
